current_prompt.body:
PROVIDE a valid 4-coloring of the wheel graph W_11 using colors {1,2,3,4} such that adjacent nodes have different colors, INCLUDING the central hub node node 0 and all outer nodes 1 through 11.
DEMONSTRATE that a 3-coloring of W_11 is impossible by showing that the odd outer cycle together with the hub forces the need for a fourth color.
ENSURE that the coloring assignment and the impossibility argument are presented clearly and concisely without performing any additional analysis beyond the required result.

current_plan.body:
DEFINE the wheel graph W_11 with hub node 0 and outer nodes 1 through 11
SELECT a 4‑color palette {1,2,3,4}
ASSIGN colors to hub and outer nodes ensuring that every edge connects nodes of different colors
VERIFY that the resulting assignment satisfies all adjacency constraints
FORMAT the coloring assignment for clear presentation
ARGUE that any 3‑coloring would require the outer odd cycle to be 2‑colorable, which is impossible, and that the hub then forces a fourth color
STRUCTURE the impossibility argument concisely
